subject: KitePath pilot: temporary invoice-only onboarding / PO exemption
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir@kitepath.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, Oct 22, 2025 at 9:12 AM -0700
Subject: Pilot onboarding — ask for invoice-only path for first invoices

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at KitePath is excited to kick off a 6-week pilot. Procurement here is slower than expected and we won’t have a formal PO number for the first invoice window.

Can Redwood make a temporary exception for an invoice-only onboarding for the first 30 days (estimate ~$8k), while our legal & procurement finish the PO and W9 paperwork? We can provide:
- Company details and billing contact (attached)
- A short SOW for the pilot

If you need a limit or an approval owner on your side, happy to accept that as a condition. We’d like to start next Tuesday (Oct 28).

Attaching: onboarding_evidence.xlsx (company details, pilot SOW)

Best,
Samir Rao
Head of Cloud Ops, KitePath
samir@kitepath.com
+1 415-555-0198
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.inference>
To: Samir Rao <samir@kitepath.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>, david_kim <david@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, Oct 22, 2025 at 10:03 AM -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — ask for invoice-only path for first invoices

Hi Samir — thanks for the clear note and the attachment.

Onboarding delays are common; we do have a temporary invoice-only process for pilots but it requires a short set of controls so we can approve without a PO:
- Evidence packet (W9, company profile) — looks like you included that, thanks.
- Trial cap (we typically set a $10k cap for the first 30 days)
- A delegated approver on the Redwood side (we can route to our Sales Ops or Procurement contact)
- Signed MSA or a redline we can accept via DocuSign

I’ve looped in David from procurement to scope the exception and Marissa (CS/AM) to coordinate start date and billing. David — can we do an invoice-only exception capped at $10k, net30, while KitePath returns the signed MSA? If so, I’ll confirm start date for Oct 28.

Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
From: David Kim <david@redwood.inference>
To: Samir Rao <samir@kitepath.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa@redwood.inference>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, Oct 23, 2025 at 11:45 AM -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — ask for invoice-only path for first invoices

Samir — appreciate the attachment. We can approve a temporary invoice-only onboarding with these guardrails: 
1) One-time pilot cap: $10,000 total for the first 30 days. Any charges beyond that require a formal PO.
2) Payment terms: Net30.
3) Required docs before first invoice: signed MSA (DocuSign link below), completed vendor intake fields (we received the spreadsheet but need W9 + remit-to address).
4) Approval owner on Redwood side: Marissa Cole (AM) will authorize the invoice path and sign off once documents are in.

I’ve prepared a redline of our standard MSA marked for trial pilots — attaching kitepath_msa_redline.pdf. If you can return the signed MSA via DocuSign within 48 hours after countersign, we’ll mark this exception in the vendor record and allow the first invoice.

DocuSign link (MSA countersign): https://docusign.com/sandbox/XYZ-msa-kitepath
HubSpot deal: https://redwood.app/hubspot/deal/12345 (for tracking approvals)

We’ll also add a note for Finance to route the first invoice through the temporary invoice lane; please address invoices to accounts@kitepath.com with the deal id KP-2025-0017 in the subject.

If all good, Tessa — please confirm the start date so CS can provision trial capacity.

Thanks,
David Kim
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Samir Rao <samir@kitepath.com>
To: David Kim <david@redwood.inference>, tessa_morgan <tessa@redwood.inference>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>, Jenna Liu <jenna@kitepath.com>
Date: Fri, Oct 24, 2025 at 3:47 PM -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — ask for invoice-only path for first invoices

David / Tessa — that approach works for us.

We’ve signed the MSA and uploaded it to the DocuSign link you provided. Attaching a copy here for your records: kitepath_msa_signed.pdf. W9 and remit details are in the onboarding_evidence.xlsx we sent earlier; I’ve also asked our finance team to send a PDF of the W9 to procurement@redwood.inference.

We accept the $10k cap and Net30. Please confirm once Finance marks the vendor record as 'temporary invoice-only' and we’ll plan to invoice after go-live on Oct 29 (one day later than originally requested).

Appreciate the quick coordination — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Samir Rao
Head of Cloud Ops, KitePath
Attachments: kitepath_msa_signed.pdf
